[P1] Verify active retry coverage before releasing the lease

Only deferred requests receive a coverage check here. An `activeAtObservationEnd` retry can have no in-window events when native admission precedes the cutoff but wrapper initialization follows it. An independent snapshot omitting that retry can pass `validate_retirement_evidence()`, and `_cleanup_record_errors()` cannot detect the omission without event/request references. This permits target reuse without proving the retry's quiescence; `audit_cutoff()` detects it only after scheduling. Require every active-at-cutoff request to have a matching completed attempt in the audited snapshot, and cover the omitted-retry case with no in-window events.
